tourSessionAnalysisIntro: Track mastery gains and rank-ups during observed live sessions.
tourSessionAnalysisDetail: Choose the current session or a history period to see mastery XP, observed rates and the session timeline. History is saved privately on this device for the current account.
tourSessionAnalysisTip: Tracking starts from a live baseline. Saved inventory and offline play do not create sessions or gains.
tourCollectionLogIntro: Track weapons, armour, Pacts, cosmetics and discoveries against the published game catalogue.
tourCollectionLogDetail: Search or choose a category, filter missing items, and use the star to pin goals. Ownership reflects the current inventory; XP history preserves previously used gear.
tourCollectionLogTip: Discoveries shows published memory targets and world tree progress. Missing inventory sections show as unavailable.
tourCosmeticsIntro: Keep track of the adornments and skins in your collection.
tourCosmeticsDetail: Search the catalogue, filter owned or missing cosmetics, and star the pieces you want to collect.
tourCosmeticsTip: Live and saved inventory labels show how recent your ownership information is.
tourMasteryTrackerIntro: See Envoy Rank calculated from the mastery contributions in your inventory.
tourMasteryTrackerDetail: Switch between rank, checklist and goals. Search equipment, filter unmastered items, and star the weapons or Pacts you want to level.
tourMasteryTrackerTip: Equipment XP history, completed discoveries and available skill ranks determine Envoy Rank using published XP tables. Missing records are marked as partial; account-reported levels do not set your rank.
tourResourcesIntro: Browse crafting resources and consumables with current inventory quantities.
tourResourcesDetail: Search or filter the resource list to see what you hold and what is missing.
tourResourcesTip: Quantities are inventory balances; buying, crafting and spending all affect them.
tourEnhancementsIntro: Review your runes, motes, totems, techniques and joineries.
tourEnhancementsDetail: Choose a category, virtue or rank to narrow the list. Counts come from raw and upgraded inventory entries.
tourEnhancementsTip: Missing upgrade sections are shown as unavailable rather than empty.
tourCraftingPlannerIntro: Choose crafting targets and compare their recipe ingredients with your inventory.
tourCraftingPlannerDetail: Find a recipe and add it to your goals. Set quantities to combine ingredient requirements across the plan and see the remaining materials.
tourCraftingPlannerTip: Plans are saved on this device. A recipe may describe a reforge and require an existing item.
tourActivityIntro: Follow observed resource and currency changes during your live session.
tourActivityDetail: The feed starts after a live inventory baseline. Use the gains filter to focus on increases, or include spending to see reductions.
tourActivityTip: This is an inventory change feed. Purchases, crafting and consumption also appear as changes.
tourCraftingLogIntro: Review the completed recipes recorded by your ancestors.
tourCraftingLogDetail: Search completed recipes and inspect recorded craftwork tiers and ancestor progress.
tourCraftingLogTip: Recipes appear when they are present in the game inventory; this panel does not create a history for earlier sessions.
tourBossIntro: Keep boss cooldowns in view while you play. Timers appear when Overkot reads them from your Soulframe session.
tourBossDetail: Each row shows the remaining time and a progress bar. Ready means the countdown has finished. Popup and sound alerts can be changed in Settings.
tourBossTip: An empty panel means no boss timers are available yet.
tourCraftingIntro: Watch your active crafting countdowns without leaving the game. Overkot reads these timers from your current Soulframe session.
tourCraftingDetail: The countdown and progress bar update automatically. Choose popup and sound alerts in Settings if you want a reminder when a timer finishes.
tourCraftingTip: Start crafting in game to give this panel something to track.
tourOtherIntro: This panel collects countdowns that do not belong to bosses or crafting, including temporary effects read from your game session.
tourOtherDetail: Each row shows the remaining time. Timers refresh automatically as new game data arrives; Ready means the recorded countdown has ended.
tourOtherTip: Popup and sound alerts are controlled in Settings.
tourAffiliationIntro: See how much daily affiliation you have earned and how much remains toward the daily cap.
tourAffiliationDetail: The earned total, progress bar, and remaining amount update from your Soulframe session. Connect to the game if the panel has no data.
tourAffiliationTip: The display follows game data; earning affiliation still happens in Soulframe.
tourFactionsIntro: Keep an eye on your standing with the Champions, the Fey, and the Silent Rose.
tourFactionsDetail: Each faction shows its current rank and progress within that rank. The bar fills as your recorded standing increases.
tourFactionsTip: Your faction data refreshes from your Soulframe session.
tourOdeinfamyIntro: View your recorded Ode Infamy progress alongside the rest of your overlay.
tourOdeinfamyDetail: The panel reads your current game data automatically. If it is empty, wait for Overkot to connect to your Soulframe session.
tourOdeinfamyTip: Keep the panel docked for quick checks or float it near the part of the screen you use most.
tourWikiIntro: Look up Soulframe information directly from the overlay.
tourWikiDetail: Type a search term in the widget and press Enter. Results open in a separate wiki window so you can read while keeping the overlay nearby.
tourWikiTip: Wiki pages require an internet connection.
tourGroupfinderIntro: See your listing, open listings, and incoming requests at a glance.
tourGroupfinderDetail: Choose Open Group Finder in the widget to browse or manage listings. Use Settings → Connections to manage your avakot.dev account.
tourGroupfinderTip: Online status follows your Soulframe session.
tourMarketIntro: Browse the market and manage trades in a dedicated window launched from the dock.
tourMarketDetail: Use the Market window to browse and sign in when needed. Settings → Connections lets you control whether the market session is remembered.
tourMarketTip: The Market icon opens its own window instead of a small widget panel.
tourMinimapIntro: Explore the world map and see dungeon layouts in one panel. Dungeon mode can switch automatically when Overkot detects a dungeon.
tourMinimapDetail: Use + and − to zoom, the eye button for the legend, and the expand button for the full map. Choose the location button and press F6 in game to locate yourself from a screenshot.
tourMinimapTip: If location or dungeon detection is missing, check Settings → Game files.
tourArenaIntro: Check whether the current dungeon layout contains the wave-arena tile.
tourArenaDetail: Arena Finder uses the same decoded room tiles as Mini-Map and works while Mini-Map is closed. If tile data is unavailable, the existing game-log diagnostic acts as a backup.
tourArenaTip: Wave number and tier still come from the arena script. A new dungeon instance clears the previous result and wave.
tourWorldWatchIntro: Bring the world clock, current weather, ancestor encounter, and offerings together in one place.
tourWorldWatchDetail: Now gives you a quick overview. Forecast shows upcoming weather. Calendar shows daily encounters and offerings; clicking today’s card opens the calendar view.
tourWorldWatchTip: Choose your unlocked ancestors in Calendar settings to personalize encounters.
tourClockIntro: See the current Midrath world time and cycle while you play.
tourClockDetail: The clock refreshes automatically. Its status indicates whether time comes from the game or an estimate based on your device clock.
tourClockTip: World Watch combines this clock with weather and the calendar if you prefer one panel.
tourWeatherIntro: See the current world weather, what comes next, and the forecast timeline.
tourWeatherDetail: The countdown shows how long remains until the next forecast period. Rainbow chances appear when available. Forecast status tells you when saved data is being used.
tourWeatherTip: Quests can override local weather, so the world forecast may differ from your immediate surroundings.
tourBuildExporterIntro: Turn your currently recorded Soulframe loadout into a build draft.
tourBuildExporterDetail: Once the widget has a loadout available, use its export button to open a draft in your browser. Review and finish the draft there.
tourBuildExporterTip: Connect to Soulframe and wait for loadout data if the export button is unavailable.
tourTemperTrackerIntro: Track your tempers and weapon progress from the inventory read by Overkot.
tourTemperTrackerDetail: Switch between Blacksmith and Weapons, search by name, and use filters and grouping to narrow the list. The widget remembers your chosen view and filters.
tourTemperTrackerTip: Live and saved inventory labels help you tell how recent the displayed data is.
tourTitleTrackerIntro: Track epithet progress and keep the titles you are working toward close at hand.
tourTitleTrackerDetail: Search titles, choose whether completed or incomplete entries appear, and pin your favorites. Use the view button to switch to a compact list of pinned titles.
tourTitleTrackerTip: Your pinned titles and filters are saved for your next session.
tourPlayerIntro: Your wallet, equipment storage, XP, session gains and boons share one panel.
tourPlayerDetailTitle: Switch views without losing your place
tourPlayerDetail: Overview combines balances and storage. Equipment tracks XP, Session measures net changes, and Boons shows account timers. Each tab keeps its controls and filters when you switch away.
tourPlayerTip: Session tracking continues while Player is enabled, even when the panel is closed.
tourDailyIntro: Review daily allowances, encounters, Zenith offerings, Avakot’s Gots and faction weapons.
tourDailyDetail: Today gives your remaining allowances and encounter. Vendors includes current Avakot stock and faction weapon Tempers. Calendar lets you look ahead.
tourDailyTip: Done hides the brief until the next login or reset. Automatic opening at login and 00:00 UTC can be changed here or in Settings. The dock always opens it manually.
tourWolfTrainingIntro: See your wolf’s energy, bond, training progress, and paws that are ready to allocate.
tourWolfTrainingDetail: Paw states show training progress, trained paws, and paws allocated in game. Use Details for XP values and the legend. Rest warnings appear when the recorded companion needs rest.
tourWolfTrainingTip: Higher paw thresholds are estimates where confirmed game data is unavailable. Allocate trained paws in Soulframe.
tourDataInventoryIntro: Inspect the inventory snapshot that Overkot has read from your game session.
tourDataInventoryDetail: Use the viewer’s search and controls to inspect entries. Live or saved status tells you whether you are looking at current game data or a cached snapshot.
tourDataInventoryTip: This viewer helps you understand what data is available to other widgets.
tourDataEeLogIntro: Inspect the Soulframe game log used by Overkot for activity detection.
tourDataEeLogDetail: Use search to find messages and inspect recent activity. If the viewer cannot read the log, choose the correct EE.log location in Settings → Game files.
tourDataEeLogTip: Arena and dungeon detection depend on this log being available.
tourAppWelcomeBody: Keep timers, maps, world information, and progress in view while you play. This short tour will help you make the overlay your own.
tourAppWelcomeTip: You can skip any tutorial and replay it later in Settings → Tutorials.
tourAppFocusBody: Press {shortcut} to focus the overlay and interact with its dock and widgets. Press the chord again or Escape to return control to your game.
tourAppFocusTip: The dock stays passive until you focus it. Widget click-through can be changed in Settings → Overlay.
tourAppWidgetsBody: Use the widgets button on the dock to choose the features you want. Selected widgets add an icon to the dock; click an icon to show or hide its panel.
tourAppWidgetsTip: The first time you open a widget, you will see a short tour of its features.
tourAppArrangeBody: Hold Shift while dragging a widget to move it. Drop it on the dock to dock it again. Drag dock icons to reorder them, and choose your screen edge in Settings → Overlay.
tourAppArrangeTip: Floating widget positions and your dock order are saved.
tourAppVisibilityBody: Press {shortcut} to hide or show the overlay. This is a separate shortcut from focusing it. Change either shortcut in Settings → Overlay.
tourAppVisibilityTip: The small reminder by the app icon shows your current focus shortcut each time Overkot starts.
tourAppReadyBody: The dock status shows whether Overkot has connected to Soulframe. If maps or activity detection are missing, check your game log and screenshot folder in Settings → Game files.
tourAppReadyTip: Replay this tour or a widget tour any time in Settings → Tutorials.
tourMarketDockHint: Keep the Market icon on your dock for quick access. Drag icons to put your most-used features together.
tourDockHint: Click this widget’s dock icon to hide or show the panel. Hold Shift and drag to move it; drop it on the dock to dock it again.
tourReplayHint: Replay this tutorial in Settings → Tutorials whenever you need a reminder.
tourWidgetShortcut: Press {shortcut} whenever you need to interact with the overlay.
tourUnavailableHint: This tutorial is not available in this version of Overkot.
tourSaveFailed: Could not save your tutorial progress. Choose Done or Skip tour to retry.
